description: Weighted relationships between foods and biological mechanisms, derived transitively from food-bioactives.json x bioactive-mechanisms.json (Food -> Bioactive -> Mechanism). Not hand-curated: regenerate this file whenever either source file changes.

derivation.method: For each food, every mechanism reachable through one of its bioactives is scored as strength = min(food-bioactive strength, bioactive-mechanism strength) [the chain is only as strong as its weakest link], confidence = food-bioactive confidence x bioactive-mechanism confidence, mapping High/Moderate/Emerging to 0.95/0.87/0.75 before multiplying. Where a food reaches the same mechanism via more than one bioactive, the strongest-scoring path is kept.

strengthScale.5: Primary evidence-supported food for this mechanism

confidenceScale: 0.0-1.0 reflects confidence in the food→mechanism relationship.
